subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should configured TTS providers preserve automatic fallback by default, fail closed to the selected provider, or add an explicit strict/sticky mode for voice-identity workflows?
rationale: Current docs and tests intentionally preserve automatic fallback, while the remaining user problem is unexpected provider switching; changing that default or adding a new setting needs maintainer product and compatibility judgment.

options.title: Add opt-in sticky mode
options.body: Preserve the documented fallback default, but add a named strict/sticky TTS policy for users who want wrong-voice fallback to fail visibly instead of switching providers.

options.title: Change default to fail closed
options.body: Make configured TTS providers sticky by default, accepting upgrade risk for users who currently depend on automatic fallback when their primary provider fails.

options.title: Keep fallback as designed
options.body: Treat diagnostics and registration fixes as sufficient and close the remaining behavior as expected documented fallback semantics.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in sticky mode
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented fallback default, but add a named strict/sticky TTS policy for users who want wrong-voice fallback to fail visibly instead of switching providers.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant already carried the issue-cluster diagnostics work and explicitly identified provider stickiness as the remaining scope.
